title: Wonderful experience
text: Beautiful experience on board the extraordinary Ferrari Roma. I had the pleasure of driving for about 1 hour through the urban streets of Barcelona, with the possibility of pushing a lot on the accelerator on a stretch of the former F1 circuit. The whole driving experience was coordinated by Matteo, a qualified and very friendly Italian instructor. A short stop that turned into a mix of enthusiasm and relaxation gave us the opportunity to take some breathtaking photos at a lookout with a spectacular view. The staff at the reception, where I made the reservation, was also kind and helpful. Reco

title: Amazing!
text:
Absolutely, here’s the updated review:

My husband and I had an amazing experience driving a Ferrari with Drive Me Barcelona while exploring the beautiful city. It was an unforgettable way to see Barcelona! We especially recommend Roger, one of the staff members, who accompanied us and guided us the entire time. He made us feel safe and confident in the city’s traffic, and his personality truly added to the experience.
